fields.label: Debug mode
fields.description: Enable verbose VBWD Office plugin logging (development only).

fields.label: Max upload size (bytes)
fields.description: Largest single file a user may upload into VBWD Space. Default 52428800 (50 MiB).

fields.label: Free-tier storage quota (bytes)
fields.description: Total storage a free-tier user may hold across all documents. Default 1073741824 (1 GiB).

fields.label: Preview MIME allow-list
fields.description: MIME types the server will render an inline preview for (one per line / JSON array). Everything else downloads as an attachment.

fields.label: Public share rate limit (requests/minute)
fields.description: Per-IP cap on the /public/<token>* routes (metadata, content, unlock). Guards against token/password enumeration.

fields.label: Share access log retention (days)
fields.description: How long office_share_access audit rows are kept before an operator-run prune removes them.

fields.label: Edit lease lifetime (seconds)
fields.description: How long an editor holds exclusive edit access to a Doc before it lapses. Renewed by autosave / heartbeat while the document stays open.

fields.label: AI helper LLM connection slug
fields.description: The admin-managed LLM connection slug the AI helper addresses. Leave blank to use the active default connection; an unknown/inactive slug also falls back to the default.

fields.label: AI helper monthly call budget (per user)
fields.description: Default monthly AI-helper call budget per user. A paid plan can override this via the 'office.ai_monthly_call_budget' entitlement feature.

fields.label: AI helper max selection length (characters)
fields.description: Hard cap on the selected text forwarded to the LLM per AI-helper call, independent of what the client sends.

fields.label: AI helper max surrounding context (characters)
fields.description: Hard cap on the surrounding-text window (before/after the selection) forwarded to the LLM.
